items.title: Stripped-down Windows 11 for AI developers demands 64GB RAM and insane 250 GB/s bandwidth — Project Zenith will debut on AMD's flagship Ryzen AI Halo platform
items.description: Project Zenith is a version of Windows 11 that lets developers work right out of the box. It comes pre-installed with developer tools like Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot, and WSL 2+ Ubuntu, among others, and includes features that make developing and running AI agents more secure.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Microsoft just released another version of Windows 11 designed for developers, dubbed Project Zenith. According to the Windows Blogs, this operating system is optimized for developer workflows and will first become available on the AMD Ryzen AI Halo, Team Red’s direct answer to the Nvidia DGX Spark, although it will also arrive on more devices from Microsoft’s OEM and other silicon partners soon. Redmond calls Project Zenith “a ready-to-code distraction-free Windows experience on developer-class devices with 64 GB+ unified memory and 250+ GB/s memory bandwidth,” claiming that “developers can jump right in.”Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplySamsung debuts three next-generation memory technologies for AI data centersThe future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICsHigh-bandwidth memory roadmapInside the history of DRAM price-fixing lawsuitsIt comes with pre-installed tools like Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot, PowerToys, WinAppCLI, Windows Dev Skills, Intelligent Terminal, PowerShell 7, Git, GitHub CLI, AzureCLI, Core Utils, Oh My Posh, Python 3.14+, uv, NVM, Node 24+, WSL 2+ Ubuntu, and .NET 10. Aside from that, Microsoft said it pre-configures Windows 11 so developers don’t have to dig through the settings menus of various apps to configure them for their needs.It’s primarily designed for AI developers, especially since the devices it’s installed on are designed to run 30B+ parameter models locally and without meters. The company also made it more secure for developing and running agents, deploying features such as OS-enforced identity, containment through Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and enterprise-grade manageability for agents.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Project Zenith is Microsoft’s response to the AI token crisis, which has caused costs to spiral out of control, especially as agents use 1000x more tokens compared to standard AI. While frontier models would still be available on the cloud, AI developers could run everything else locally through devices like this, powered by this version of Windows 11. This should help AI developers keep using their agents without feeling the bite of tokenized billing, which is especially crucial for those working in smaller organizations or experimenting at home.One big tradeoff with Project Zenith, though, is that it’s only available on expensive devices, at least for the moment. The AMD Ryzen AI Halo, with its AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 processor, 128GB LPDDR5x-8000 RAM, 2TB SSD, and integrated Radeon 8060S graphics, costs $3,999.99 on Micro Center. Even if Microsoft eventually makes Project Zenith available for separate purchase and installable on other mini-PCs, the 64 GB+ unified memory requirement will be a major roadblock, especially with skyrocketing RAM prices driven by the AI boom. items.titleZh: Stripped-down Windows 11 for AI developers demands 64GB RAM and insane 250 GB/s bandwidth — Project Zenith will debut on AMD's flagship Ryzen AI Halo platform
items.descriptionZh:
微软面向开发者群体发布了一款全新的Windows 11特别版本，代号Project Zenith。这款操作系统专门针对AI开发者和本地大模型工作流优化，用微软的话说，它能在配备“64GB以上统一内存、内存带宽超过250GB/s”的开发者级设备上，提供“开箱即写代码、心无旁骛”的Windows体验。首批搭载该系统的设备是AMD Ryzen AI Halo——正是AMD用来直接对标Nvidia DGX Spark的高性能迷你工作站，后续微软还将与更多OEM及芯片合作伙伴合作，把Project Zenith扩展到更多设备上。

Project Zenith诞生的直接原因是“AI token危机”。随着AI智能体（agent）大规模普及，其运行过程中消耗的token数量可能是普通AI应用的1000倍，导致按token计费的云API成本急剧失控。微软的思路是：前沿大模型仍然留在云端，但AI开发者在本地高性能设备上完成绝大多数开发、测试和agent执行工作，从而绕开持续上涨的token账单。这一设计尤其照顾小型AI团队、自由开发者和在家做实验的技术人员，让他们不必因为计费压力而放弃复杂agent项目。

为了做到“打开电脑就能写代码”，Project Zenith预装了一整套开发工具链，包括Visual Studio Code、GitHub Copilot、PowerToys、WinAppCLI、Windows Dev Skills、Intelligent Terminal、PowerShell 7、Git、GitHub CLI、Azure CLI、Core Utils、Oh My Posh、Python 3.14+、uv、NVM、Node 24+、WSL 2+ Ubuntu以及.NET 10等。更重要的是，微软将这些工具与Windows 11的开发者相关设置预先配置完毕，开发者无需再花时间逐个应用打开设置菜单调整环境，直接进入编码状态。

在安全层面，Project Zenith也为AI代理的本地开发与运行引入了平台级机制：包括操作系统强制执行的开发者与代理身份验证、基于Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC)的隔离环境，以及面向agent的企业级可管理能力。这意味着本地运行自动化代理时，不仅能获得系统级隔离，还能像管理企业软件一样统一控制和审计。

Project Zenith的目标是让设备在本地流畅运行300亿参数以上的大语言模型，并且不按token计量收费。作为首发硬件的AMD Ryzen AI Halo，搭载Ryzen AI Max+ 395处理器、128GB LPDDR5x-8000内存、2TB SSD和集成的Radeon 8060S显卡，目前Micro Center售价为3999.99美元。这样的硬件配置足以应付高参数模型的推理与微调，同时也与微软设定的“64GB+统一内存”“250GB/s+内存带宽”硬指标相匹配。

不过，Project Zenith目前的门槛也非常明显：仅随昂贵的高端设备提供。即便未来微软将其做成可单独安装的Windows版本，市场普及仍面临两大障碍——64GB起步的统一内存要求，以及AI热潮推动下内存价格持续高涨，都让普通用户和预算有限的开发者难以轻易跨入。与此同时，微软此前承诺优化Windows 11在8GB内存设备上的流畅度，反而从侧面表明Project Zenith是面向高端开发场景的小众产品。

整体来看，Project Zenith可以视为微软对AI智能体经济的一次平台级回应：它借助系统预配置、本地算力优化、开发者工具集成和agent安全机制，尝试把被token成本裹挟的AI开发者重新拉回本地环境，在云端大模型与本地执行之间创造新的平衡。对于频繁运行超大模型或重度依赖AI代理的开发者来说，这是一种更可控、更具成本效率的开发方式；至于它能否成为潮流，很大程度上取决于未来统一内存设备的价格走势。

items.title: We tested DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 with every RTX 50-series GPU — first official release comes with a big performance hit, but almost every Blackwell card can run it at 1080p
items.description: We tested Nvidia's DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 across every RTX 50-series graphics card at 1080p, 1440p, and 4K to see just how much performance it costs to explore the frontiers of neural rendering.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's DLSS 5 has arrived in NBA 2K27, and we've been up since midnight testing it across every RTX 50-series graphics card to see what the first official implementation of this tech can do and how it compares to the community-implemented mods that have been circulating over the past couple weeks.Before we discuss the performance cost of DLSS 5, many will ask whether this tech is even worth getting excited about, given the intense controversy that it's sparked ever since Nvidia revealed it earlier this year.In short: yes, absolutely.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: This first-party implementation of DLSS 5, tuned under the full control of 2K Games' art directors and artists, looks incredible, full stop. If you see it running, you will want to leave it on. It doesn't look like "slop" or a cheap filter. It just looks correct, or at least more correct. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: 2K) (Image credit: 2K) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original For just a couple of examples, without DLSS 5, even at ultra settings and with RT, the game has a slightly "plastic" or "flat" look. Faces can have a waxy uniformity that immediately indicates that you're looking at a video game, not a live broadcast. Hair looks totally and unnaturally flat. The whites of eyes can be unnaturally bright, giving a sort of googly-eye or doll-like effect that immediately broke my sense of immersion. I didn't think any of this would be a big deal for a sports game, but it all stands out. You may like DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27 only on RTX 50-series, but coming to RTX 40-series soon We explored early DLSS 5 performance with community mods DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: 2K) (Image credit: 2K) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original DLSS 5 breathes incredible life into NBA 2K27. Skin looks like real flesh and blood. Eyes are rendered with the proper tones, depth, and sparkle. Hair looks a billion times more realistic. Every human on screen just looks more alive. You won't entirely forget that you're looking at a game, but it becomes much easier to suspend disbelief and get lost in the action.My experience slapping DLSS 5 mods into games has produced promising but sometimes mixed results. If the polished experience that NBA 2K25 delivers is any indication, I can't wait for more studios to get their hands on it and integrate it into their games under the care of the same artists that created them.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsOur testing methodsWe did our best to deliver clean test numbers in the short time we've had with NBA 2K27. Performance in this can be tricky to measure. Benchmarking in the hub worlds or cutscenes will deliver lower performance than on the court, and even then, in-game events like fouls and time-outs will also result in skewed numbers if you're not careful. We picked a repeatable match-up from the game's career mode and sampled 60 seconds of continuous gameplay with DLSS 5 on and off, making sure to restart if we ran into any of the scripted events above.We used NBA 2K27's maximum graphics settings as our baseline, including RT. We tested at native resolutions without upscaling, and we didn't test with Multi Frame Generation enabled. We view MFG as a cherry on top of an already solid baseline experience, not a baseline in itself.Our test system is built with the following components: What to read next Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 will launch September 3 with NBA2K27, company shares first benchmarks Modders get leaked DLSS 5 running in Control Modder gets Nvidia's DLSS 5 working on AMD RDNA 4 GPUs in any DirectX 12 game Swipe to scroll horizontally Tom's Hardware 2026 GPU Test System CPU AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU Cooler Thermalright Phantom Spirit 120SE Memory 32GB (2x16GB) G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 CL30 Motherboard Asus TUF Gaming X670E-Plus Wifi Storage Inland Performance Plus 4TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD Power supply MSI MPG Ai1600TS 1600W Operating system Windows 11 Pro Graphics driver version GeForce Game Ready 616.64 All of our performance results are captured using Nvidia's FrameView 2.0 utility. We measure graphics card power consumption directly with Nvidia's PCAT hardware power logging tool.If you have any questions about our testing methods, let us know in the comments and we'll do our best to answer them. On to the numbers.NBA 2K27 1080p performance (Image credit: Future)At 1080p, everything from the RTX 5070 on up is CPU-bound without DLSS 5 enabled, even with maxed-out settings and RT on. Turn on DLSS 5, though, and the differences in Tensor Core compute across the cards quickly becomes obvious. But even the RTX 5060 can manage nearly 60 FPS on average with DLSS 5 enabled at 1080p, so almost anybody with a Blackwell card can at least try out the feature.Given these results, you might think to enable DLSS Super Resolution (aka upscaling). But because the amount of time needed to run the DLSS 5 model has a fixed cost per output frame that scales with your target resolution and largely dominates the total frame time, especially on lower-end hardware, you may find that enabling DLSS SR doesn't have as much of an effect on performance as we've come to expect. The game still has to wait for that final generative step to occur, even if DLSS SR cuts down some of the total frame time.As noted, we didn't use MFG for these tests, simply because there's no need for us to make the numbers on these charts artifically large. If you do want to enable it, the multiplier you want will be determined by your monitor's refresh rate and your own personal tastes. (Image credit: Future)We did chart PC latency as estimated by FrameView, so you can get a sense of whether there's enough of a latency budget to enable MFG at all. At 1080p, every card is a solid candidate for enabling MFG without adding unreasonable amounts of input latency, although the RTX 5050 is in a borderline position. And all three of the 8GB cards might have trouble fitting the MFG model into their VRAM with these maxed-out settings and DLSS 5 enabled, so you might need to turn off RT at a minimum to use MFG on these lower-end GPUs. (Image credit: Future)As we already saw in early testing of the leaked DLSS 5 builds circulating in the community, enabling the model has a large impact on power consumption, likely due to the intense Tensor Core load required to run the DLSS 5 model.NBA 2K27 1440p performance (Image credit: Future)Moving up to 1440p separates our cards some more. The RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 are still CPU-limited without DLSS 5. The RTX 5060 Ti 8GB, RTX 5060, and RTX 5050 all get a "Low VRAM" warning with these settings, so if you're trying to push this higher resolution with those cards, you might want to start tuning your DLSS upscaling settings to relieve VRAM pressure, even if it doesn't result in additional performance with DLSS 5. (Image credit: Future)But you really want an RTX 5060 Ti at a minimum here to get acceptable input latency with DLSS 5 enabled, and the RTX 5070 is the true baseline for a good experience. At the higher end, the RTX 5070 Ti and RTX 5080 both provide fluid frame rates even without MFG, and you have the latency budget to enable framegen without worry on anything from the RTX 5070 on up. (Image credit: Future)DLSS 5's power consumption on all these cards (except the chugging RTX 5050) rises as expected with the higher-resolution output frame we're asking it to generate. Everything from the RTX 5060 up to the RTX 5070 Ti ends up running at its power limit, while the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 still have room to stretch out. The unconstrained MSI RTX 5090 Lighting Z sucks down a ton of power to deliver its scorching performance.NBA 2K27 4K performance (Image credit: Future)Running NBA 2K27 at 4K with DLSS 5 is extremely demanding, since the model has to generate an output frame with more than twice as many pixels than at 1440p. Even the RTX 5070 Ti is straining here, as its input latency with DLSS 5 is potentially too high to enable MFG while still delivering a responsive gameplay experience. (Image credit: Future)You can see why Nvidia only recommends the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 for a 4K DLSS 5 experience in this title, as they're the only two cards that deliver high enough baseline performance with low enough input latencies to make MFG practical. And even then, the RTX 5080 is on the edge of what we'd consider an acceptable input latency before enabling MFG. (Image credit: Future)Our power consumption chart at 4K is a bit of a mess at the low end since the RTX 5050 and RTX 5060 are crushed by the demands of DLSS 5 and end up chugging. Really, though, we're here to see how the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090s handle this incredibly Tensor Core-intensive work. Both cards end up running at their power limits.The MSI RTX 5090 Lightning Z shows how much power scaling the GB202 GPU has left in it once you remove the constraint of a single 12V-2x6 connector. We were wondering whether the power numbers we saw from a modded version of Control were a fluke, but DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 goes even harder and pushes the RTX 5090 Lightning Z to nearly 850W on average in this test. For 48% more power than the RTX 5090 Founders Edition, you get 22% higher performance.On a big 4K screen like an OLED TV, a fluid 90 FPS at a native 4K resolution with the level of detail and realism that DLSS 5 adds is an astounding gaming experience. You really haven't seen anything like it. But mere mortals with single-plug 5090s will probably want to enable MFG 2X at a minimum.Bottom lineIt's early days for DLSS 5 performance, and in its first official showing in NBA 2K27, it certainly has a large performance cost—sometimes well over 50% on lower-end hardware. But the generational leap in realism it provides for every human on screen is well worth it to my eye, at least. Now that I've seen a first-party, developer-driven implementation of DLSS 5, I want it in every game where its photorealistic enhancements would make sense, without question.And as it's implemented in NBA 2K27, our performance results show that the tech is accessible enough that almost anybody with an RTX 50-series graphics card can try it out and still enjoy a fluid and responsive experience, even without Multi Frame Generation. Most of us aren't playing on 4K monitors, and at 1080p and 1440p, the Blackwell card you may already have is probably up to the task of running DLSS 5 with acceptable baseline performance.DLSS 5 does upend some intuitions we've developed around the interactions of upscaling and frame rate. The large fixed frame-time cost that's required to generate the DLSS 5 output frame is entirely dependent on your target output resolution, making the lowered input resolution of DLSS 4.5 upscaling far less of a performance multiplier than it might otherwise be.Given those realities, DLSS MFG can still make for a more fluid experience alongside DLSS 5 with a couple of clicks in a menu—at least assuming you have enough VRAM to hold the game assets, the DLSS 5 model, and the MFG model all at once. On 8GB graphics cards, this may require some tweaking to get working.Nvidia has promised to continue improving the fundamental performance of the DLSS 5 model with time, and the fact that it's moved from requiring a dedicated RTX 5090 to run in the demos we saw at GTC to running on an RTX 5060 today is a sign that such promises do bear fruit.Boosting the fundamental performance of the DLSS 5 model is vital, because as we all well know, prices for most Blackwell cards have spiked across the board to the point that former midrange options like the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB and RTX 5070 are many hundreds of dollars more expensive than their MSRPs and well out of whack with their former performance-per-dollar propositions. A hardware upgrade to get better performance is no longer a no-brainer for many PC builders, and that problem is going to get even worse as the AI boom continues unabated.Those elevated prices are also why Nvidia's post-launch pledge to bring the DLSS 5 model to RTX 40-series cards later this year is a welcome development. In our limited experience with community mods, Ada GPUs run the current DLSS 5 model about as well as Blackwell cards do, and gamers who haven't already upgraded from their 40-series cards certainly won't be raring to move off that hardware any time soon. Locking DLSS 5 to new GPUs that are prohibitively expensive to buy for non-technical reasons isn't a winning strategy for goodwill or broad adoption, and it's good to see Nvidia acknowledge that reality.For all that, we shouldn't lose sight of the fact that DLSS 5 is a huge, exciting leap forward in the never-ending pursuit of photorealism in real-time graphics. When you toggle it on and off in NBA 2K27, it feels like a generational improvement in rendering technology at the press of a button. Now that I've seen it in action, I don't want to play NBA 2K27 without it, and I hope to see more first-party integrations of it soon.

items.titleZh: We tested DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 with every RTX 50-series GPU — first official release comes with a big performance hit, but almost every Blackwell card can run it at 1080p
items.descriptionZh:
在《NBA 2K27》中，Nvidia DLSS 5的首次官方正式亮相已经到来。这篇来自Tom's Hardware的深度评测，基于对RTX 50系列全部显卡的彻夜测试，揭示了这项自年初公布以来便争议不断的技术究竟表现如何，以及它与过去几周社区流传的mod版本有何差异。

**核心画质：从“塑料感”到“活生生”的跃升**

对于DLSS 5是否值得兴奋，答案毫无疑问是肯定的。作为由2K Games艺术总监和艺术家完全掌控调校的第一方实现，其画质表现堪称惊艳。关闭DLSS 5时，即便将画质拉满并开启光追，游戏人物依然带有微微的“塑料感”或“扁平感”：面部蜡质般千篇一律，瞬间暴露这是电子游戏而非直播画面；头发完全失真地扁平；眼白过亮产生类似玩偶的“斗鸡眼”效果，破坏沉浸感。开启DLSS 5后，这些瑕疵一扫而空：皮肤呈现真实的血肉质感，眼睛拥有正确的色调、深度与神采，头发真实感提升数个量级。屏幕上的每个人都仿佛被注入了生命，尽管无法完全忘记这是游戏，但已能轻松实现“悬置怀疑”，沉浸在比赛对抗之中。与此前体验过的社区mod时好时坏的表现相比，这种由原厂艺术家精心整合的成品效果令人期待更多工作室跟进。

**测试方法与基准设置**

由于游戏性能测量颇具挑战性，测试者特意从生涯模式中选取了可重复的对局，确保连续60秒游戏内无犯规、暂停等脚本事件干扰。测试基于游戏最高画质设置（包含光线追踪），在原生分辨率下进行，**未启用任何超分辨率缩放**，也**未启用多帧生成（MFG）**。MFG被视为锦上添花而非测试基准。测试平台采用AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器、32GB DDR5-6000内存、华硕X670E主板、Windows 11 Pro系统，并使用Nvidia FrameView 2.0记录帧率与延迟，通过Nvidia PCAT硬件记录功耗，驱动为GeForce Game Ready 616.64。

**性能实测：Tensor Core的沉重负担与分辨率门槛**

- **1080p**：在未开启DLSS 5时，从RTX 5070往上的显卡均受CPU瓶颈限制。一旦开启DLSS 5，各卡Tensor Core算力差异立刻显现。好消息是，即便入门级RTX 5060也能保持接近60 FPS的平均帧率，几乎任何Blackwell卡用户都能体验该功能。但测试发现，DLSS 5模型对每个输出帧的生成耗时是固定的，且随目标分辨率增加而大幅增长，并主导整体帧耗时，这导致即便开启DLSS超分辨率（旧版升频功能），性能提升也远不如过往——游戏仍需等待最终生成步骤完成。在延迟方面，所有显卡都有足够预算开启MFG放大帧率，但RTX 5050处于临界线；三款8GB显存显卡在画质拉满并开启DLSS 5时可能因显存不足难以同时容纳MFG模型，至少需关闭光追才能使用。DLSS 5的高Tensor Core负载使功耗显著上升。

- **1440p**：分辨率的提升进一步拉开差距。RTX 5080和5090不开DLSS 5时依然CPU瓶颈。RTX 5060 Ti 8GB、5060和5050会收到“显存不足”警告，若用这些卡攻坚1440p，建议开启升频设置以缓解显存压力，即便这不一定提升DLSS 5性能。若要获得可接受的输入延迟，至少需要RTX 5060 Ti；RTX 5070才是获得良好体验的真正门槛。中高端卡中，RTX 5070 Ti和5080即便不开MFG也能提供流畅帧率，而从RTX 5070往上都有充裕的延迟预算开启帧生成。功耗方面，从RTX 5060到5070 Ti均运行于功耗上限，5080和5090仍有裕量；未锁功耗的微星RTX 5090 Lightning Z更是吸电怪兽。

- **4K**：DLSS 5在4K下极为苛刻，因为需生成的输出帧像素数是1440p的两倍多。RTX 5070 Ti已力不从心，其开启DLSS 5后的输入延迟可能过高，无法再叠加MFG并维持流畅交互。这解释了为何Nvidia仅推荐RTX 5080和5090用于该游戏的4K DLSS 5体验——只有这两张卡能提供足够高的基准帧率和足够低的输入延迟，使MFG具备实用性。而RTX 5080在开启MFG前也已接近可接受输入延迟的临界值。功耗图表在低端卡上略显混乱，RTX 5050和5060不堪重负沦为“挣扎模式”。真正的看点在于RTX 5080/5090如何应对这种极度依赖Tensor Core的工作负载——两者均运行至功耗上限。微星RTX 5090 Lightning Z在此测试中平均功耗接近**850W**，比公版5090多消耗48%电力，换来22%性能提升。在OLED大屏上，原生4K以90 FPS流畅运行并呈现DLSS 5带来的细节与真实感，堪称震撼体验，前所未见。但普通单接口供电的5090玩家，建议至少开启MFG 2X档。

**结论与业界影响**

DLSS 5首次官方亮相的性能成本相当显著，低端硬件上有时性能损失超过50%。但其为所有“人类”角色带来的画质代际飞跃，在评测者眼中完全值回代价。这是首个由开发者驱动、第一方实施的DLSS 5，评测者希望该技术被引入所有适合呈现照片级真实感的游戏中。

实际性能结果表明，几乎所有RTX 50系列用户都能在不开启多帧生成的情况下，流畅体验DLSS 5带来的高帧率与高响应度。毕竟多数玩家尚未升级到4K显示器，在1080p与1440p下，现有的Blackwell显卡足以胜任。

DLSS 5颠覆了以往关于“升频与帧率关系”的直觉认知：生成DLSS 5输出帧所需的大额固定帧耗时完全取决于目标输出分辨率，这使DLSS 4.5版本的输入分辨率降低不再能像以往那样带来等比性能收益。在此现实下，只要显存足以同时承载游戏资产、DLSS 5模型与MFG模型，通过菜单点选开启MFG依然可获得更流畅体验。但对8GB显存的显卡而言，这可能需要调低部分设置才能实现。

Nvidia承诺将持续优化DLSS 5模型的基础性能——从GTC大会演示时需RTX 5090运行，到今天已可跑在RTX 5060上，这一进步足以证明承诺并非空谈。提升模型基础效率至关重要，因为目前大多数Blackwell显卡市场价格飞涨，昔日甜点级如RTX 5060 Ti 16GB与RTX 5070的实际售价已高于MSRP数百美元，性价比严重失衡。AI热潮之下，单纯靠升级硬件获取更好性能已不再是多数DIY玩家的明智之选。

正因价格高企，Nvidia宣布将于今年晚些时候将DLSS 5模型带入RTX 40系列才备受好评。有限的社区mod测试表明，Ada架构GPU运行现行DLSS 5模型的性能与Blackwell相当。尚未升级的40系玩家短期内也无意更换硬件。将DLSS 5锁死在因非技术因素而贵得离谱的新GPU上，绝非赢得口碑与广泛采纳的上策——Nvidia承认现实并选择下放，值得肯定。

总而言之，DLSS 5是实时图形领域追求照片级真实感进程中一次巨大且激动人心的飞跃。在《NBA 2K27》中一键切换便可感受渲染技术跨代提升的明显差异。评测者表示，体验过后已无法再接受不带DLSS 5的《NBA 2K27》，并期待更多第一方整合早日到来。

items.title: DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27, limited to RTX 50-series GPUs for now — Nvidia promises to bring neutral rendering tech to RTX 40-series soon
items.description: Nvidia's controversial neural-rendering tech, DLSS 5, is now officially available in NBA 2K27, marking the start of a new era for the company. DLSS 5 will also come to RTX 40-series soon after current work on optimizing it for the RTX 50-series has reached a satisfactory state.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter After a heavily scrutinized announcement earlier this year and a very revealing past few days, DLSS 5 has finally, officially launched inside NBA 2K27. A sports game is a bit of an unusual choice to showcase what is seemingly the next big leap in real-time rendering, but it's the only game DLSS 5 works with for now. Fortunately, you don't need an RTX 50-series GPU to enjoy it, as Nvidia has confirmed that the tech is coming to previous-gen RTX 40-series hardware as well, though we don't know exactly when.Nvidia has worked closely with developer Visual Concepts to leverage DLSS 5 as an aid rather than the foundation of NBA 2K27. The game still uses scanned 3D models of all the players to form the base geometry. Then, DLSS 5 combines training data and engine data to infer things like lighting and shadows, upgrading the scene to look more photorealistic. Such engine-level implementation allows devs to fine-tune the end result as per their creative intent instead of just applying a global AI filter over everything. (Image credit: Nvidia / Take-Two Interactive)DLSS 5 will come to other titles soon, but for now it's limited to NBA 2K27, and even then, it's extremely taxing. Nvidia's own marketing shows DLSS 5 netting 370 FPS at 4K with an RTX 5090, compared to 240 FPS with DLSS turned off. What it doesn't highlight as clearly is that the 370 FPS number comes from 6x MFG — five fake frames being interpolated for every real frame. That means the game is actually running at ~61 FPS; turning on DLSS 5 tanked performance by four times compared to native. Not to mention, it's being upscaled from 1080p to 4K, too.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: If you don't happen to own the latest-and-greatest in Blackwell silicon, and you also don't want to pay for the Ultimate tier of GeForce Now (RTX 5080), there's still some good news for you. After initially locking DLSS 5 to only the RTX 50-series, Nvidia has confirmed it'll bring the 3D-guided neural rendering tech to RTX 40-series GPUs soon. "Once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series," said Ben Berraondo, head of PR at the company.Hey @firstadopter, Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model updates expected later this fall. Once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series.September 4, 2026It's likely that modders opening the floodgates for patched DLLs convinced, or perhaps forced, Nvidia to reconsider its initial stance. It's no secret that DLSS 5 has a merciless compute cost, so making it work on older Ada GPUs would only result in negative PR for an already divisive product. But once modders showed it's possible — not just on the 40-series, but also on the 30- and even 20-series — the ball was in Nvidia's court and, to its credit, the game hasn't stopped. It'll be interesting to see the performance, considering the RTX 40-series only has up to 2x MFG. You may like Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 will launch September 3 with NBA2K27, company shares first benchmarks DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible For now, the focus is entirely on optimizing DLSS 5 for RTX 50-series, and that improvement will, in turn, help the future release on RTX 40-series, too. As more and more games implement the tech, the dataset behind it will mature, and DLSS 5 might one day grow to distinguish itself from AI slop for its critics. At the moment, don't expect granular control like we've seen through ReShade, as that's entirely a community effort. DLSS 5 will simply be an on/off toggle in most titles since the devs would've already tweaked the individual parameters themselves. items.titleZh: DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27, limited to RTX 50-series GPUs for now — Nvidia promises to bring neutral rendering tech to RTX 40-series soon
items.descriptionZh:
经过年初备受争议的发布预告和最近几天的密集信息披露，DLSS 5终于随《NBA 2K27》正式上线。以一款体育游戏来展示实时渲染领域的下一次大跨越显得有些不同寻常，但就目前而言，DLSS 5仅支持这一款作品。好消息是，玩家不需要RTX 50系列显卡也能享受这项技术——英伟达已确认它将同步扩展到上一代RTX 40系列硬件，只是尚未公布具体时间。

在技术实现上，英伟达与开发商Visual Concepts紧密合作，将DLSS 5定位为辅助工具而非核心渲染基础。《NBA 2K27》依然采用球员的扫描3D模型作为基础几何体，DLSS 5则通过结合训练数据与引擎数据来推断光照、阴影等细节，从而将场景提升至更接近照片写实的水平。这种引擎级的集成方式允许开发团队根据创作意图对最终画面进行细致调节，而不是对所有画面简单套用一个全局的AI滤镜。

性能参数方面，英伟达官方宣传数据显示，在RTX 5090上开启DLSS 5时，《NBA 2K27》能在4K分辨率下达到370帧/秒，相比之下关闭DLSS时为240帧/秒。但这份数据并未明确点出，370帧/秒的成绩其实是基于6倍多帧生成（6x MFG）实现的，即每帧真实画面会额外插值出5帧虚拟画面，实际游戏原生帧数约为61帧/秒。换句话说，开启DLSS 5后真实渲染性能反而只有原生状态的四分之一，同时画面还是从1080p超采样到4K的。这一数字与营销宣传中的直观感受形成了明显反差。

除了RTX 50系列，英伟达最初将DLSS 5锁定为仅限该平台使用，但现在该公司已确认将逐步把这项基于3D引导的神经渲染技术带到RTX 40系列显卡上。英伟达公关负责人Ben Berraondo在回复中表示：“我们当前的首要任务是针对RTX 50系列优化性能，预计今年秋季推出模型更新。一旦RTX 50系列性能得到更充分地调优，我们计划着手扩展对GeForce RTX 40系列的正式支持。”值得注意的是，这项决定很可能与来自社区的破解行为有关——玩家通过修改DLL文件，不仅让DLSS 5在RTX 40系上运行，甚至能在RTX 30系和20系老显卡上启动。考虑到DLSS 5具有庞大的计算开销，官方此前对Ada架构能否流畅运行持怀疑态度。但社区证明其可行性后，英伟达显然被迫重新考虑了立场。不过，RTX 40系列最高仅支持2倍多帧生成，实际性能表现仍有待观察。

就现阶段而言，英伟达的全部工作重心仍是为RTX 50系列调优DLSS 5，而这一过程中积累的优化成果也会惠及未来RTX 40系列的支持。与此同时，随着越来越多游戏采用该技术，其背后的数据集会逐步成熟，DLSS 5也有望最终回应批评者对“AI换皮”的质疑。不过玩家短期内不要指望能获得类似ReShade那样精细的参数调节，因为大多数游戏只会提供开/关选项——具体细节参数已由开发者在引擎开发阶段预先设定好了。

history.titleZh: Stripped-down Windows 11 for AI developers demands 64GB RAM and insane 250 GB/s bandwidth — Project Zenith will debut on AMD's flagship Ryzen AI Halo platform
history.descriptionZh:
微软面向开发者群体发布了一款全新的Windows 11特别版本，代号Project Zenith。这款操作系统专门针对AI开发者和本地大模型工作流优化，用微软的话说，它能在配备“64GB以上统一内存、内存带宽超过250GB/s”的开发者级设备上，提供“开箱即写代码、心无旁骛”的Windows体验。首批搭载该系统的设备是AMD Ryzen AI Halo——正是AMD用来直接对标Nvidia DGX Spark的高性能迷你工作站，后续微软还将与更多OEM及芯片合作伙伴合作，把Project Zenith扩展到更多设备上。

Project Zenith诞生的直接原因是“AI token危机”。随着AI智能体（agent）大规模普及，其运行过程中消耗的token数量可能是普通AI应用的1000倍，导致按token计费的云API成本急剧失控。微软的思路是：前沿大模型仍然留在云端，但AI开发者在本地高性能设备上完成绝大多数开发、测试和agent执行工作，从而绕开持续上涨的token账单。这一设计尤其照顾小型AI团队、自由开发者和在家做实验的技术人员，让他们不必因为计费压力而放弃复杂agent项目。

为了做到“打开电脑就能写代码”，Project Zenith预装了一整套开发工具链，包括Visual Studio Code、GitHub Copilot、PowerToys、WinAppCLI、Windows Dev Skills、Intelligent Terminal、PowerShell 7、Git、GitHub CLI、Azure CLI、Core Utils、Oh My Posh、Python 3.14+、uv、NVM、Node 24+、WSL 2+ Ubuntu以及.NET 10等。更重要的是，微软将这些工具与Windows 11的开发者相关设置预先配置完毕，开发者无需再花时间逐个应用打开设置菜单调整环境，直接进入编码状态。

在安全层面，Project Zenith也为AI代理的本地开发与运行引入了平台级机制：包括操作系统强制执行的开发者与代理身份验证、基于Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC)的隔离环境，以及面向agent的企业级可管理能力。这意味着本地运行自动化代理时，不仅能获得系统级隔离，还能像管理企业软件一样统一控制和审计。

Project Zenith的目标是让设备在本地流畅运行300亿参数以上的大语言模型，并且不按token计量收费。作为首发硬件的AMD Ryzen AI Halo，搭载Ryzen AI Max+ 395处理器、128GB LPDDR5x-8000内存、2TB SSD和集成的Radeon 8060S显卡，目前Micro Center售价为3999.99美元。这样的硬件配置足以应付高参数模型的推理与微调，同时也与微软设定的“64GB+统一内存”“250GB/s+内存带宽”硬指标相匹配。

不过，Project Zenith目前的门槛也非常明显：仅随昂贵的高端设备提供。即便未来微软将其做成可单独安装的Windows版本，市场普及仍面临两大障碍——64GB起步的统一内存要求，以及AI热潮推动下内存价格持续高涨，都让普通用户和预算有限的开发者难以轻易跨入。与此同时，微软此前承诺优化Windows 11在8GB内存设备上的流畅度，反而从侧面表明Project Zenith是面向高端开发场景的小众产品。

整体来看，Project Zenith可以视为微软对AI智能体经济的一次平台级回应：它借助系统预配置、本地算力优化、开发者工具集成和agent安全机制，尝试把被token成本裹挟的AI开发者重新拉回本地环境，在云端大模型与本地执行之间创造新的平衡。对于频繁运行超大模型或重度依赖AI代理的开发者来说，这是一种更可控、更具成本效率的开发方式；至于它能否成为潮流，很大程度上取决于未来统一内存设备的价格走势。

history.title: We tested DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 with every RTX 50-series GPU — first official release comes with a big performance hit, but almost every Blackwell card can run it at 1080p
history.description: We tested Nvidia's DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 across every RTX 50-series graphics card at 1080p, 1440p, and 4K to see just how much performance it costs to explore the frontiers of neural rendering.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's DLSS 5 has arrived in NBA 2K27, and we've been up since midnight testing it across every RTX 50-series graphics card to see what the first official implementation of this tech can do and how it compares to the community-implemented mods that have been circulating over the past couple weeks.Before we discuss the performance cost of DLSS 5, many will ask whether this tech is even worth getting excited about, given the intense controversy that it's sparked ever since Nvidia revealed it earlier this year.In short: yes, absolutely.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: This first-party implementation of DLSS 5, tuned under the full control of 2K Games' art directors and artists, looks incredible, full stop. If you see it running, you will want to leave it on. It doesn't look like "slop" or a cheap filter. It just looks correct, or at least more correct. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: 2K) (Image credit: 2K) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original For just a couple of examples, without DLSS 5, even at ultra settings and with RT, the game has a slightly "plastic" or "flat" look. Faces can have a waxy uniformity that immediately indicates that you're looking at a video game, not a live broadcast. Hair looks totally and unnaturally flat. The whites of eyes can be unnaturally bright, giving a sort of googly-eye or doll-like effect that immediately broke my sense of immersion. I didn't think any of this would be a big deal for a sports game, but it all stands out. You may like DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27 only on RTX 50-series, but coming to RTX 40-series soon We explored early DLSS 5 performance with community mods DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: 2K) (Image credit: 2K) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original DLSS 5 breathes incredible life into NBA 2K27. Skin looks like real flesh and blood. Eyes are rendered with the proper tones, depth, and sparkle. Hair looks a billion times more realistic. Every human on screen just looks more alive. You won't entirely forget that you're looking at a game, but it becomes much easier to suspend disbelief and get lost in the action.My experience slapping DLSS 5 mods into games has produced promising but sometimes mixed results. If the polished experience that NBA 2K25 delivers is any indication, I can't wait for more studios to get their hands on it and integrate it into their games under the care of the same artists that created them.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsOur testing methodsWe did our best to deliver clean test numbers in the short time we've had with NBA 2K27. Performance in this can be tricky to measure. Benchmarking in the hub worlds or cutscenes will deliver lower performance than on the court, and even then, in-game events like fouls and time-outs will also result in skewed numbers if you're not careful. We picked a repeatable match-up from the game's career mode and sampled 60 seconds of continuous gameplay with DLSS 5 on and off, making sure to restart if we ran into any of the scripted events above.We used NBA 2K27's maximum graphics settings as our baseline, including RT. We tested at native resolutions without upscaling, and we didn't test with Multi Frame Generation enabled. We view MFG as a cherry on top of an already solid baseline experience, not a baseline in itself.Our test system is built with the following components: What to read next Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 will launch September 3 with NBA2K27, company shares first benchmarks Modders get leaked DLSS 5 running in Control Modder gets Nvidia's DLSS 5 working on AMD RDNA 4 GPUs in any DirectX 12 game Swipe to scroll horizontally Tom's Hardware 2026 GPU Test System CPU AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU Cooler Thermalright Phantom Spirit 120SE Memory 32GB (2x16GB) G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 CL30 Motherboard Asus TUF Gaming X670E-Plus Wifi Storage Inland Performance Plus 4TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD Power supply MSI MPG Ai1600TS 1600W Operating system Windows 11 Pro Graphics driver version GeForce Game Ready 616.64 All of our performance results are captured using Nvidia's FrameView 2.0 utility. We measure graphics card power consumption directly with Nvidia's PCAT hardware power logging tool.If you have any questions about our testing methods, let us know in the comments and we'll do our best to answer them. On to the numbers.NBA 2K27 1080p performance (Image credit: Future)At 1080p, everything from the RTX 5070 on up is CPU-bound without DLSS 5 enabled, even with maxed-out settings and RT on. Turn on DLSS 5, though, and the differences in Tensor Core compute across the cards quickly becomes obvious. But even the RTX 5060 can manage nearly 60 FPS on average with DLSS 5 enabled at 1080p, so almost anybody with a Blackwell card can at least try out the feature.Given these results, you might think to enable DLSS Super Resolution (aka upscaling). But because the amount of time needed to run the DLSS 5 model has a fixed cost per output frame that scales with your target resolution and largely dominates the total frame time, especially on lower-end hardware, you may find that enabling DLSS SR doesn't have as much of an effect on performance as we've come to expect. The game still has to wait for that final generative step to occur, even if DLSS SR cuts down some of the total frame time.As noted, we didn't use MFG for these tests, simply because there's no need for us to make the numbers on these charts artifically large. If you do want to enable it, the multiplier you want will be determined by your monitor's refresh rate and your own personal tastes. (Image credit: Future)We did chart PC latency as estimated by FrameView, so you can get a sense of whether there's enough of a latency budget to enable MFG at all. At 1080p, every card is a solid candidate for enabling MFG without adding unreasonable amounts of input latency, although the RTX 5050 is in a borderline position. And all three of the 8GB cards might have trouble fitting the MFG model into their VRAM with these maxed-out settings and DLSS 5 enabled, so you might need to turn off RT at a minimum to use MFG on these lower-end GPUs. (Image credit: Future)As we already saw in early testing of the leaked DLSS 5 builds circulating in the community, enabling the model has a large impact on power consumption, likely due to the intense Tensor Core load required to run the DLSS 5 model.NBA 2K27 1440p performance (Image credit: Future)Moving up to 1440p separates our cards some more. The RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 are still CPU-limited without DLSS 5. The RTX 5060 Ti 8GB, RTX 5060, and RTX 5050 all get a "Low VRAM" warning with these settings, so if you're trying to push this higher resolution with those cards, you might want to start tuning your DLSS upscaling settings to relieve VRAM pressure, even if it doesn't result in additional performance with DLSS 5. (Image credit: Future)But you really want an RTX 5060 Ti at a minimum here to get acceptable input latency with DLSS 5 enabled, and the RTX 5070 is the true baseline for a good experience. At the higher end, the RTX 5070 Ti and RTX 5080 both provide fluid frame rates even without MFG, and you have the latency budget to enable framegen without worry on anything from the RTX 5070 on up. (Image credit: Future)DLSS 5's power consumption on all these cards (except the chugging RTX 5050) rises as expected with the higher-resolution output frame we're asking it to generate. Everything from the RTX 5060 up to the RTX 5070 Ti ends up running at its power limit, while the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 still have room to stretch out. The unconstrained MSI RTX 5090 Lighting Z sucks down a ton of power to deliver its scorching performance.NBA 2K27 4K performance (Image credit: Future)Running NBA 2K27 at 4K with DLSS 5 is extremely demanding, since the model has to generate an output frame with more than twice as many pixels than at 1440p. Even the RTX 5070 Ti is straining here, as its input latency with DLSS 5 is potentially too high to enable MFG while still delivering a responsive gameplay experience. (Image credit: Future)You can see why Nvidia only recommends the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 for a 4K DLSS 5 experience in this title, as they're the only two cards that deliver high enough baseline performance with low enough input latencies to make MFG practical. And even then, the RTX 5080 is on the edge of what we'd consider an acceptable input latency before enabling MFG. (Image credit: Future)Our power consumption chart at 4K is a bit of a mess at the low end since the RTX 5050 and RTX 5060 are crushed by the demands of DLSS 5 and end up chugging. Really, though, we're here to see how the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090s handle this incredibly Tensor Core-intensive work. Both cards end up running at their power limits.The MSI RTX 5090 Lightning Z shows how much power scaling the GB202 GPU has left in it once you remove the constraint of a single 12V-2x6 connector. We were wondering whether the power numbers we saw from a modded version of Control were a fluke, but DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 goes even harder and pushes the RTX 5090 Lightning Z to nearly 850W on average in this test. For 48% more power than the RTX 5090 Founders Edition, you get 22% higher performance.On a big 4K screen like an OLED TV, a fluid 90 FPS at a native 4K resolution with the level of detail and realism that DLSS 5 adds is an astounding gaming experience. You really haven't seen anything like it. But mere mortals with single-plug 5090s will probably want to enable MFG 2X at a minimum.Bottom lineIt's early days for DLSS 5 performance, and in its first official showing in NBA 2K27, it certainly has a large performance cost—sometimes well over 50% on lower-end hardware. But the generational leap in realism it provides for every human on screen is well worth it to my eye, at least. Now that I've seen a first-party, developer-driven implementation of DLSS 5, I want it in every game where its photorealistic enhancements would make sense, without question.And as it's implemented in NBA 2K27, our performance results show that the tech is accessible enough that almost anybody with an RTX 50-series graphics card can try it out and still enjoy a fluid and responsive experience, even without Multi Frame Generation. Most of us aren't playing on 4K monitors, and at 1080p and 1440p, the Blackwell card you may already have is probably up to the task of running DLSS 5 with acceptable baseline performance.DLSS 5 does upend some intuitions we've developed around the interactions of upscaling and frame rate. The large fixed frame-time cost that's required to generate the DLSS 5 output frame is entirely dependent on your target output resolution, making the lowered input resolution of DLSS 4.5 upscaling far less of a performance multiplier than it might otherwise be.Given those realities, DLSS MFG can still make for a more fluid experience alongside DLSS 5 with a couple of clicks in a menu—at least assuming you have enough VRAM to hold the game assets, the DLSS 5 model, and the MFG model all at once. On 8GB graphics cards, this may require some tweaking to get working.Nvidia has promised to continue improving the fundamental performance of the DLSS 5 model with time, and the fact that it's moved from requiring a dedicated RTX 5090 to run in the demos we saw at GTC to running on an RTX 5060 today is a sign that such promises do bear fruit.Boosting the fundamental performance of the DLSS 5 model is vital, because as we all well know, prices for most Blackwell cards have spiked across the board to the point that former midrange options like the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB and RTX 5070 are many hundreds of dollars more expensive than their MSRPs and well out of whack with their former performance-per-dollar propositions. A hardware upgrade to get better performance is no longer a no-brainer for many PC builders, and that problem is going to get even worse as the AI boom continues unabated.Those elevated prices are also why Nvidia's post-launch pledge to bring the DLSS 5 model to RTX 40-series cards later this year is a welcome development. In our limited experience with community mods, Ada GPUs run the current DLSS 5 model about as well as Blackwell cards do, and gamers who haven't already upgraded from their 40-series cards certainly won't be raring to move off that hardware any time soon. Locking DLSS 5 to new GPUs that are prohibitively expensive to buy for non-technical reasons isn't a winning strategy for goodwill or broad adoption, and it's good to see Nvidia acknowledge that reality.For all that, we shouldn't lose sight of the fact that DLSS 5 is a huge, exciting leap forward in the never-ending pursuit of photorealism in real-time graphics. When you toggle it on and off in NBA 2K27, it feels like a generational improvement in rendering technology at the press of a button. Now that I've seen it in action, I don't want to play NBA 2K27 without it, and I hope to see more first-party integrations of it soon.
history.author: Jeffrey Kampman
history.titleZh: We tested DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27 with every RTX 50-series GPU — first official release comes with a big performance hit, but almost every Blackwell card can run it at 1080p
history.descriptionZh:
在《NBA 2K27》中，Nvidia DLSS 5的首次官方正式亮相已经到来。这篇来自Tom's Hardware的深度评测，基于对RTX 50系列全部显卡的彻夜测试，揭示了这项自年初公布以来便争议不断的技术究竟表现如何，以及它与过去几周社区流传的mod版本有何差异。

**核心画质：从“塑料感”到“活生生”的跃升**

对于DLSS 5是否值得兴奋，答案毫无疑问是肯定的。作为由2K Games艺术总监和艺术家完全掌控调校的第一方实现，其画质表现堪称惊艳。关闭DLSS 5时，即便将画质拉满并开启光追，游戏人物依然带有微微的“塑料感”或“扁平感”：面部蜡质般千篇一律，瞬间暴露这是电子游戏而非直播画面；头发完全失真地扁平；眼白过亮产生类似玩偶的“斗鸡眼”效果，破坏沉浸感。开启DLSS 5后，这些瑕疵一扫而空：皮肤呈现真实的血肉质感，眼睛拥有正确的色调、深度与神采，头发真实感提升数个量级。屏幕上的每个人都仿佛被注入了生命，尽管无法完全忘记这是游戏，但已能轻松实现“悬置怀疑”，沉浸在比赛对抗之中。与此前体验过的社区mod时好时坏的表现相比，这种由原厂艺术家精心整合的成品效果令人期待更多工作室跟进。

**测试方法与基准设置**

由于游戏性能测量颇具挑战性，测试者特意从生涯模式中选取了可重复的对局，确保连续60秒游戏内无犯规、暂停等脚本事件干扰。测试基于游戏最高画质设置（包含光线追踪），在原生分辨率下进行，**未启用任何超分辨率缩放**，也**未启用多帧生成（MFG）**。MFG被视为锦上添花而非测试基准。测试平台采用AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器、32GB DDR5-6000内存、华硕X670E主板、Windows 11 Pro系统，并使用Nvidia FrameView 2.0记录帧率与延迟，通过Nvidia PCAT硬件记录功耗，驱动为GeForce Game Ready 616.64。

**性能实测：Tensor Core的沉重负担与分辨率门槛**

- **1080p**：在未开启DLSS 5时，从RTX 5070往上的显卡均受CPU瓶颈限制。一旦开启DLSS 5，各卡Tensor Core算力差异立刻显现。好消息是，即便入门级RTX 5060也能保持接近60 FPS的平均帧率，几乎任何Blackwell卡用户都能体验该功能。但测试发现，DLSS 5模型对每个输出帧的生成耗时是固定的，且随目标分辨率增加而大幅增长，并主导整体帧耗时，这导致即便开启DLSS超分辨率（旧版升频功能），性能提升也远不如过往——游戏仍需等待最终生成步骤完成。在延迟方面，所有显卡都有足够预算开启MFG放大帧率，但RTX 5050处于临界线；三款8GB显存显卡在画质拉满并开启DLSS 5时可能因显存不足难以同时容纳MFG模型，至少需关闭光追才能使用。DLSS 5的高Tensor Core负载使功耗显著上升。

- **1440p**：分辨率的提升进一步拉开差距。RTX 5080和5090不开DLSS 5时依然CPU瓶颈。RTX 5060 Ti 8GB、5060和5050会收到“显存不足”警告，若用这些卡攻坚1440p，建议开启升频设置以缓解显存压力，即便这不一定提升DLSS 5性能。若要获得可接受的输入延迟，至少需要RTX 5060 Ti；RTX 5070才是获得良好体验的真正门槛。中高端卡中，RTX 5070 Ti和5080即便不开MFG也能提供流畅帧率，而从RTX 5070往上都有充裕的延迟预算开启帧生成。功耗方面，从RTX 5060到5070 Ti均运行于功耗上限，5080和5090仍有裕量；未锁功耗的微星RTX 5090 Lightning Z更是吸电怪兽。

- **4K**：DLSS 5在4K下极为苛刻，因为需生成的输出帧像素数是1440p的两倍多。RTX 5070 Ti已力不从心，其开启DLSS 5后的输入延迟可能过高，无法再叠加MFG并维持流畅交互。这解释了为何Nvidia仅推荐RTX 5080和5090用于该游戏的4K DLSS 5体验——只有这两张卡能提供足够高的基准帧率和足够低的输入延迟，使MFG具备实用性。而RTX 5080在开启MFG前也已接近可接受输入延迟的临界值。功耗图表在低端卡上略显混乱，RTX 5050和5060不堪重负沦为“挣扎模式”。真正的看点在于RTX 5080/5090如何应对这种极度依赖Tensor Core的工作负载——两者均运行至功耗上限。微星RTX 5090 Lightning Z在此测试中平均功耗接近**850W**，比公版5090多消耗48%电力，换来22%性能提升。在OLED大屏上，原生4K以90 FPS流畅运行并呈现DLSS 5带来的细节与真实感，堪称震撼体验，前所未见。但普通单接口供电的5090玩家，建议至少开启MFG 2X档。

**结论与业界影响**

DLSS 5首次官方亮相的性能成本相当显著，低端硬件上有时性能损失超过50%。但其为所有“人类”角色带来的画质代际飞跃，在评测者眼中完全值回代价。这是首个由开发者驱动、第一方实施的DLSS 5，评测者希望该技术被引入所有适合呈现照片级真实感的游戏中。

实际性能结果表明，几乎所有RTX 50系列用户都能在不开启多帧生成的情况下，流畅体验DLSS 5带来的高帧率与高响应度。毕竟多数玩家尚未升级到4K显示器，在1080p与1440p下，现有的Blackwell显卡足以胜任。

DLSS 5颠覆了以往关于“升频与帧率关系”的直觉认知：生成DLSS 5输出帧所需的大额固定帧耗时完全取决于目标输出分辨率，这使DLSS 4.5版本的输入分辨率降低不再能像以往那样带来等比性能收益。在此现实下，只要显存足以同时承载游戏资产、DLSS 5模型与MFG模型，通过菜单点选开启MFG依然可获得更流畅体验。但对8GB显存的显卡而言，这可能需要调低部分设置才能实现。

Nvidia承诺将持续优化DLSS 5模型的基础性能——从GTC大会演示时需RTX 5090运行，到今天已可跑在RTX 5060上，这一进步足以证明承诺并非空谈。提升模型基础效率至关重要，因为目前大多数Blackwell显卡市场价格飞涨，昔日甜点级如RTX 5060 Ti 16GB与RTX 5070的实际售价已高于MSRP数百美元，性价比严重失衡。AI热潮之下，单纯靠升级硬件获取更好性能已不再是多数DIY玩家的明智之选。

正因价格高企，Nvidia宣布将于今年晚些时候将DLSS 5模型带入RTX 40系列才备受好评。有限的社区mod测试表明，Ada架构GPU运行现行DLSS 5模型的性能与Blackwell相当。尚未升级的40系玩家短期内也无意更换硬件。将DLSS 5锁死在因非技术因素而贵得离谱的新GPU上，绝非赢得口碑与广泛采纳的上策——Nvidia承认现实并选择下放，值得肯定。

总而言之，DLSS 5是实时图形领域追求照片级真实感进程中一次巨大且激动人心的飞跃。在《NBA 2K27》中一键切换便可感受渲染技术跨代提升的明显差异。评测者表示，体验过后已无法再接受不带DLSS 5的《NBA 2K27》，并期待更多第一方整合早日到来。

history.title: DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27, limited to RTX 50-series GPUs for now — Nvidia promises to bring neutral rendering tech to RTX 40-series soon
history.description: Nvidia's controversial neural-rendering tech, DLSS 5, is now officially available in NBA 2K27, marking the start of a new era for the company. DLSS 5 will also come to RTX 40-series soon after current work on optimizing it for the RTX 50-series has reached a satisfactory state.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter After a heavily scrutinized announcement earlier this year and a very revealing past few days, DLSS 5 has finally, officially launched inside NBA 2K27. A sports game is a bit of an unusual choice to showcase what is seemingly the next big leap in real-time rendering, but it's the only game DLSS 5 works with for now. Fortunately, you don't need an RTX 50-series GPU to enjoy it, as Nvidia has confirmed that the tech is coming to previous-gen RTX 40-series hardware as well, though we don't know exactly when.Nvidia has worked closely with developer Visual Concepts to leverage DLSS 5 as an aid rather than the foundation of NBA 2K27. The game still uses scanned 3D models of all the players to form the base geometry. Then, DLSS 5 combines training data and engine data to infer things like lighting and shadows, upgrading the scene to look more photorealistic. Such engine-level implementation allows devs to fine-tune the end result as per their creative intent instead of just applying a global AI filter over everything. (Image credit: Nvidia / Take-Two Interactive)DLSS 5 will come to other titles soon, but for now it's limited to NBA 2K27, and even then, it's extremely taxing. Nvidia's own marketing shows DLSS 5 netting 370 FPS at 4K with an RTX 5090, compared to 240 FPS with DLSS turned off. What it doesn't highlight as clearly is that the 370 FPS number comes from 6x MFG — five fake frames being interpolated for every real frame. That means the game is actually running at ~61 FPS; turning on DLSS 5 tanked performance by four times compared to native. Not to mention, it's being upscaled from 1080p to 4K, too.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: If you don't happen to own the latest-and-greatest in Blackwell silicon, and you also don't want to pay for the Ultimate tier of GeForce Now (RTX 5080), there's still some good news for you. After initially locking DLSS 5 to only the RTX 50-series, Nvidia has confirmed it'll bring the 3D-guided neural rendering tech to RTX 40-series GPUs soon. "Once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series," said Ben Berraondo, head of PR at the company.Hey @firstadopter, Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model updates expected later this fall. Once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series.September 4, 2026It's likely that modders opening the floodgates for patched DLLs convinced, or perhaps forced, Nvidia to reconsider its initial stance. It's no secret that DLSS 5 has a merciless compute cost, so making it work on older Ada GPUs would only result in negative PR for an already divisive product. But once modders showed it's possible — not just on the 40-series, but also on the 30- and even 20-series — the ball was in Nvidia's court and, to its credit, the game hasn't stopped. It'll be interesting to see the performance, considering the RTX 40-series only has up to 2x MFG. You may like Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 will launch September 3 with NBA2K27, company shares first benchmarks DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible For now, the focus is entirely on optimizing DLSS 5 for RTX 50-series, and that improvement will, in turn, help the future release on RTX 40-series, too. As more and more games implement the tech, the dataset behind it will mature, and DLSS 5 might one day grow to distinguish itself from AI slop for its critics. At the moment, don't expect granular control like we've seen through ReShade, as that's entirely a community effort. DLSS 5 will simply be an on/off toggle in most titles since the devs would've already tweaked the individual parameters themselves. history.titleZh: DLSS 5 officially launches inside NBA 2K27, limited to RTX 50-series GPUs for now — Nvidia promises to bring neutral rendering tech to RTX 40-series soon
history.descriptionZh:
经过年初备受争议的发布预告和最近几天的密集信息披露，DLSS 5终于随《NBA 2K27》正式上线。以一款体育游戏来展示实时渲染领域的下一次大跨越显得有些不同寻常，但就目前而言，DLSS 5仅支持这一款作品。好消息是，玩家不需要RTX 50系列显卡也能享受这项技术——英伟达已确认它将同步扩展到上一代RTX 40系列硬件，只是尚未公布具体时间。

在技术实现上，英伟达与开发商Visual Concepts紧密合作，将DLSS 5定位为辅助工具而非核心渲染基础。《NBA 2K27》依然采用球员的扫描3D模型作为基础几何体，DLSS 5则通过结合训练数据与引擎数据来推断光照、阴影等细节，从而将场景提升至更接近照片写实的水平。这种引擎级的集成方式允许开发团队根据创作意图对最终画面进行细致调节，而不是对所有画面简单套用一个全局的AI滤镜。

性能参数方面，英伟达官方宣传数据显示，在RTX 5090上开启DLSS 5时，《NBA 2K27》能在4K分辨率下达到370帧/秒，相比之下关闭DLSS时为240帧/秒。但这份数据并未明确点出，370帧/秒的成绩其实是基于6倍多帧生成（6x MFG）实现的，即每帧真实画面会额外插值出5帧虚拟画面，实际游戏原生帧数约为61帧/秒。换句话说，开启DLSS 5后真实渲染性能反而只有原生状态的四分之一，同时画面还是从1080p超采样到4K的。这一数字与营销宣传中的直观感受形成了明显反差。

除了RTX 50系列，英伟达最初将DLSS 5锁定为仅限该平台使用，但现在该公司已确认将逐步把这项基于3D引导的神经渲染技术带到RTX 40系列显卡上。英伟达公关负责人Ben Berraondo在回复中表示：“我们当前的首要任务是针对RTX 50系列优化性能，预计今年秋季推出模型更新。一旦RTX 50系列性能得到更充分地调优，我们计划着手扩展对GeForce RTX 40系列的正式支持。”值得注意的是，这项决定很可能与来自社区的破解行为有关——玩家通过修改DLL文件，不仅让DLSS 5在RTX 40系上运行，甚至能在RTX 30系和20系老显卡上启动。考虑到DLSS 5具有庞大的计算开销，官方此前对Ada架构能否流畅运行持怀疑态度。但社区证明其可行性后，英伟达显然被迫重新考虑了立场。不过，RTX 40系列最高仅支持2倍多帧生成，实际性能表现仍有待观察。

就现阶段而言，英伟达的全部工作重心仍是为RTX 50系列调优DLSS 5，而这一过程中积累的优化成果也会惠及未来RTX 40系列的支持。与此同时，随着越来越多游戏采用该技术，其背后的数据集会逐步成熟，DLSS 5也有望最终回应批评者对“AI换皮”的质疑。不过玩家短期内不要指望能获得类似ReShade那样精细的参数调节，因为大多数游戏只会提供开/关选项——具体细节参数已由开发者在引擎开发阶段预先设定好了。
